research.title: How Will Higher-than-Expected Inflation Data Impact the Fed's Next Rate Decisions?
research.summary: While a smaller hike remains more likely, October’s hotter-than-expected inflation data may open the door to a 50-basis point rate hike at the Fed’s December meeting, says Muhammad Qubbaj, co-head of North America Interest Rate Product Sales and Trading in Goldman Sachs FICC and Equities. A recent drop in oil prices is unlikely to give the Fed cover to look past the CPI number without becoming more aggressive in the inflation fight, Qubbaj says on this episode of The Markets podcast. He also explains why his base case is for the 10-Year Treasury yield to remain below recent highs. This episode was recorded on November 12, 2026.

Our specialists discuss potential challenges and opportunities in the AI buildout. Read more insights from Morgan Stanley.

research.title: Revving the ETF vehicle: Roundhill’s CEO on DRAM, next-gen innovation and more
research.summary: What does the next generation of ETF innovation look like? In this episode of Making Sense, Funmi Osiyale, from J.P. Morgan’s ETF Sales team, is joined by Dave Mazza, CEO of Roundhill Investments, to discuss Roundhill’s approach to identifying investment opportunities and the thinking behind innovative ETFs, including DRAM and MAGS. They also explore the return of thematic ETFs, how investor demand is influencing product development, and what could be next for the broader ETF landscape.
